name: xero
description: Read Xero evidence for invoice readiness and unbilled-work review without changing provider records.

auth.label: Xero OAuth access token
auth.hint: Attach an xero-oauth credential containing secret_accessToken and configure tenantId. On OrgSDK 0.1.0 this is a manually managed OAuth access token; renew it externally before expiry. Native Xero OAuth onboarding requires a future host release.

marketplace.tagline: Read Xero source evidence for reviewed invoice drafts.
useCases: Compare project/time evidence with existing invoices
Build reviewed drafts in OrgSDK without writing to the provider
marketplace.permissionsSummary: Reads the configured authorised Xero organisation only: invoices/bills, contacts and invoice attachment metadata. Every call verifies the tenant against /connections. No writes, email, payments, deletion or file downloads.
